g.text: Plan PR Loop - Fixes, Rechecks and One Merge Condition
Plan branch; all Ticket checks passed
Verify PR head/base match Plan Branch/Base
Plan Status: in_review; persist canonical PR link
Keep same Plan branch and PR
Record cause + logs + resume stage; Issue stays open
Never treat timeout, exit 0 or missing output as pass
Recorded review pass + required checks passed
PR head still equals reviewed head
Merge Plan PR once; verify MERGED and exact refs
Then cleanup / sync / close Plan + Tickets
Return to Slice loop before publishing
Arrows resume only the recorded failed stage;
Environment/dependency blockers set Plan/Ticket Status: blocked.
Restore Plan in_review when the existing PR is ready for review.
No Plan or Ticket is closed merely because code was pushed.
PR/metadata cause resolved; query before create
review cause resolved; inspect saved run first
affected tests fail; diagnose and correct
affected tests pass; publish batch once
Slice loop and Ticket acceptance pass again
